title: eludite.agents.start input
description: Start an ACP agent in the Agents window (View > Agents): spawn it, run ACP initialize and session/new with Eludite's MCP server, and report its state. With no `agent`, the window's selected agent (by default the first of the registry: the native Claude Code adapter when found, then the npx adapter, then the agents configured in settings). Starting an agent that is already running does nothing unless `restart` is true.

agent.description: The name of an agent in the registry (see the output's `agents`), for example `Claude Code`.

restart.description: Stop the running session (if any) and start a new one.
